newsitem.title: UK: India's Power Finance Corp starts roadshows soon.
newsitem.headline: India's Power Finance Corp starts roadshows soon.

text.p: India's state-run Power Finance Corporation (PFC) will start roadshows for its debut Eurobond next week, bankers said on Friday.
The bond is expected to be for around $100 million with a 12-year maturity, dealers said.
ING Barings is lead manager of the transaction but could not comment on the deal due to U.S. regulations.
The roadshow starts in Hong Kong on Tuesday, moves to the U.S. and Europe, hitting London on July 23, bankers said.
PFC, which lends funds for power projects, has the sovereign rating of BB+ by Standard & Poor's and Baa3 by Moody's Investors Service.
In March, India's Finance Ministry gave permission to PFC to launch a $100-$125 million Euro issue.
PFC set a $75 million syndicated loan via Natwest in January.
